SELECT , m.name AS initiatorMerchantName, m.logo_url AS initiatorMerchantLogo
FROM joint_marketing_plan AS plan JOIN merchants AS m ON plan.initiator_merchant_id = m.id
WHERE plan.is_deleted = 0 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND plan.status = 'DRAFT' AND plan.audit_status = 'PENDING'
AND plan.name LIKE CONCAT( #{dto.planName}, '%')
AND m.name LIKE CONCAT( #{dto.merchantName}, '%')
ORDER BY plan.updated_time
